items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room (higher-output replacement)
items.rationale: Surge from lightning (2.3.3) damaged a fixed unit 9 m from the hob, so 2.3.10(c) does not apply. Under 7.1.9/7.1.10 the upgraded 7.1 kW unit is still a replacement, but indemnity is limited to an equivalent 3.5 kW unit at the like-for-like rate.
Labour to remove, fit and commission the replacement of an affected installation is covered (7.1.9(c)); the reference rate is about 482.
A console chosen for room appearance and not required by the new unit is not a replacement cost at all (7.1.10 last paragraph, 3.5(d), 7.1.8(a)).
Ordinary carriage of the covered replacement is indemnified (7.1.9(e), 7.1.12). There may be a small apportionment for the console (7.1.11), giving about 40-42.
Expedited or timed delivery surcharges are expressly excluded (7.1.12), with no prior insurer consent and no loss-mitigation need.
Administrative and processing charges are not a repair cost (7.1.8(b)).
